title: Trump: PH to be a ‘very natural partner’ in new oil pipeline in Alaska

blocks.text: The US has constructed a “major new pipeline in Alaska to export affordable abundant supplies of energy to our allies and friends across the Pacific,” Trump said during his bilateral meeting with Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. in Malacañang.
